title: The bird on her shoulder
logline: Two days after she lit the firework: Gully's daughter, fifteen, on the dock from behind, and the bird on her shoulder. The first person it lands on. She doesn't move. The page doesn't either.

panels.composition: A fifteen-year-old girl from behind on a dock looking at the bay with the small rainbow bird perched on her shoulder, both still.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a fifteen-year-old girl seen from behind on a wooden dock looking at a bay with a small rainbow bird perched on her shoulder, both still, no words
image.notes: The first person it lands on.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
